Still, she swung the great lamp north. Its beam crossed the dark water and caught a small fishing boat drifting without power. Mara sounded the alarm and guided the rescue crew to its position. Mara smiled at the curious answer the sea had delivered.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有真正醒来。街灯把湿漉漉的路面照成浅金色，昨夜的雨水沿着屋檐滴落。几辆公交车空荡荡地驶过路口，车窗映着孤零零的灯火。早餐店掀开卷帘门，蒸汽和面香悄悄漫上街头；清洁工推着车，扫走树叶与纸屑。高楼之间，偶尔传来一声鸟鸣，像是替沉睡的人们报信。远处的天边泛起灰蓝，窗户一扇接一扇亮起来。城市在寂静中缓缓换气，等待清晨抵达。","w03":"- Recursion is when a process solves a problem by calling a smaller version of itself.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then another, until you find the toy.\n- It needs a stopping point, or it would keep opening boxes forever."}
